Sociolinguistic survey (vitality, dialect perception, literacy attitudes) with no phonology/tone/accent section; the only hit for 'accent' is about foreign accent in an FSI proficiency scale. Annexe D survey wordlists (Kouchane, Sounta, Yaouada, Téré, collected 2004) are phonetic IPA and carry IPA primary-stress marks on some items without comment (p. 41: kuˈri 'poule', duguˈdi 'queue', kɑˈmɑl 'chameau', ˈnɑmɑr 'éléphant'); the reproduced literature lists (Jungraithmayr 1971, Doornbos) use tone diacritics instead.
